name: go-humanize
description_en: Go Humans! (formatters for units to human friendly sizes)
readme_excerpt: Humane Units Just a few functions for helping humanize times and sizes. go get it as github.com/dustin/go-humanize, import it as "github.com/dustin/go-humanize", use it as humanize. See godoc for complete documentation. See the test coverage report for coverage details. Sizes This lets you take numbers like 82854982 and convert them to useful strings like, 83 MB or 79 MiB (whichever you prefer).
